nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## How to use - tested on RTX 3060 12 GB

1. Load an image of ONE object (the background is removed for you).
2. **Model**: Pixal3D (3:51 on the 3060) or TRELLIS.2 (5:33). Both give a textured .glb.
3. **Texture size** 4096 = sharpest, 2048 = faster. Press **Run**; the mesh opens in the 3D viewer node.

Double-click the node to see every step. **Colours inside the node:** 🟦 load models · 🟩 your input (pose, face, frames) · 🟪 prompt + conditioning · 🟧 sampling · 🟨 decode + video · ⬛ settings + switches · 🟦‍ cyan = extras (side by side)

widgets_values:
## Downloads - put each file in the ComfyUI folder shown

Click a file name to download it. Put it in the folder shown (inside `ComfyUI/models/`).

**[Comfy-Org/Pixal3D](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pixal3D mode (12 GB tested) | `diffusion_models/` | [pixal3d_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/diffusion_models/pixal3d_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 5.6 GB |
| all | `clip_vision/` | [dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/clip_vision/dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors) | 1.2 GB |
| all | `vae/` | [trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/vae/trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 1.1 GB |
| all | `vae/` | [trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/resolve/main/vae/trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors) | 0.9 GB |

**[Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRELLIS.2 mode (12 GB tested) | `diffusion_models/` | [trellis_2_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/trellis_2_int8_convrot.safetensors) | 5.3 GB |

**[Comfy-Org/BiRefNet](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| all | `background_removal/` | [birefnet.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet/resolve/main/background_removal/birefnet.safetensors) | 0.4 GB |

**[Comfy-Org/MoGe](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MoGe)**

| For | Folder | File (click = download) | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| all | `geometry_estimation/` | [moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MoGe/resolve/main/geometry_estimation/moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors) | 0.7 GB |
